senses.gloss: m.(b. h. אָמָן; אמן, ימן)skilled, artist, artisan, professional cook, architect &c.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 34b:3">Ab. Zar. 34ᵇ</cite> <he>מורייס א׳</he> brine prepared by a professional manufacturer and dealer.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> <he>מדעת א׳</he> after the plan of an architect.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 11:1">Pesik. R. s. 11</cite> <he>שאינו א׳ וכ׳</he> who is not skilled in climbing up.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>אוּמָנִין</he> <cite ref="Berakhot 16a:7">Ber. 16ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
